## Problem Statement

Describe the problem you're trying to solve. What workflow is painful or impossible today?

## Proposed Solution

How should this work? Be specific about the user-facing behavior.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you think about? Why is the proposed solution better?

## Use Case

Describe a concrete scenario where this feature would help. Include your API provider, model, and typical workflow if relevant.

## Additional Context

Links to relevant docs, similar implementations in other projects, or screenshots.
